description: Compression, cam and multi-point latching hardware for doors, panels and enclosures — engineered for sealing, security and fast access.
Quarter-turn cam latches and replacement cams that deliver quick access with a simple turn.
Replacement and accessory cams for adjustable-grip quarter-turn latches.
Lock plugs and keys that let OEMs and end users tailor key code assignments to their application.
Lock plugs purchased independently from their matching latches, with keys in a range of codes.

Whether compressing gaskets to provide sealing against dust or water, or clamping to prevent noise and vibration, Southco's extensive line of compression latches provides robust solutions to hold doors and panels closed.

Our Lever Latches offer a simple, reliable, and user-friendly solution for securing doors, panels, and enclosures. These versatile latches utilize a lever-actuated mechanism for quick engagement and disengagement, providing secure closure and easy access when needed. From industrial equipment and enclosures to access panels and storage compartments, our Lever Latches deliver dependable performance and convenient operation.

Our Lift and Turn Latches offer a simple, secure, and user-friendly solution for fastening doors, panels, and enclosures. These versatile latches combine an intuitive lift-and-turn action for easy operation with a reliable locking mechanism for secure closure. From access panels and enclosures to doors and compartments, our Lift and Turn Latches provide dependable performance and convenient access.

Our Quarter-Turn Latches offer a fast, reliable, and user-friendly solution for securing access panels, doors, and enclosures. These versatile latches provide an ideal quarter-turn locking action for applications requiring frequent access and dependable closure. From electronics and industrial equipment to transportation and HVAC, our Quarter-Turn Latches deliver secure fastening and convenient operation.

Our Self-Adjusting Latches provide a unique and reliable solution for applications where varying panel thicknesses or tolerances are a challenge. These innovative latches automatically adjust to maintain a consistent clamping force, ensuring a secure and vibration-resistant closure every time. From enclosures and access panels to doors and compartments, our Self-Adjusting Latches deliver dependable performance and eliminate the need for manual adjustments.
Swinghandles and multi-point latching systems for large doors and enclosures.
Actuators, cams and integrated components for multi-point latching systems.
